deadline.quote: Applications for students wishing to enroll in the Physics PhD program for Fall 2027 are due by December 3, 2026.

gre_subject.value: Full consideration with or without the Physics GRE; no preselection on scores
gre_subject.quote: we will give full consideration to all applications, with or without Physics GRE scores; in particular there will be no preselection based on GRE scores prior to the holistic review

funding.value: Prevailing stipend plus tuition and fees for six years in good standing
funding.quote: Doctoral students normally receive the annual prevailing stipend (or salary, in the case of student officers) and appropriate tuition, health fees, University service and support fees, and if applicable, international fees, for six years

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a bachelor's degree with three years of undergraduate physics; admitted students are treated as PhD candidates.
entry_route.quote: Three years of fundamental undergraduate physics courses, individual laboratories, and a working knowledge of ordinary differential equations are generally required for admission.

also.quote: All students accepted for graduate study are usually assumed to be candidates for the PhD degree.

app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable fee of $120 must accompany the completed form.

fee_waiver.value: GSAS considers waivers for financial need, personal hardship or other onerous circumstances
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School will consider a waiver of the application fee for applicants who demonstrate financial need, personal hardship, or other circumstances that make paying the application fee unduly onerous.

gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is allowed but not required; the choice is yours.

notes: Three letters; personal statement. One of the earliest deadlines in this list.
